Fill any other required fields the part form demands. On the ticket '{{runid}} RD Bench Ticket' (reference {{01-open.ticket_reference}}), add a second part named exactly '{{runid}} RD Part B' with cost 200 and markup 25. Save the change, wait for the view to refresh, and report the part's updated cost, markup, and the price the app computes for it now, plus the ticket's overall parts total.

On the ticket '{{runid}} RD Bench Ticket' (reference {{01-open.ticket_reference}}), attempt to change the ticket's status to 'Ready'.
